invariants: Each sample_id has exactly one current physical location
A geometry_id may have multiple entities; a sample_id must not be duplicated into multiple samples
Source cell numbers are design-parameter keys, not substitutes for task entity IDs
All raw records bind snapshots of actual entity/hole/load/coordinate states at acquisition
Derived records reference only saved raw IDs and do not rewrite failed raw records
Replacing speakers, swapping lens cells, moving obstacles or reregistering coordinates changes the condition signature; retain old data without silently combining conditions

Record every state transition required by the selected branch for each entity; measurement/assembly are required only when assigned to that entity. Do not skip required branch events and directly mark completion.

coordinates.tube: The source defines x=0 at the sample's left face and 0<x<L; register fixed scene-hole coordinates and sample L each time. Label the source's 7 cm numerical-validation spacing separately from default scene-port coordinates.
coordinates.field: The source plane is x-z and obstacle coordinates are ordered (z,x); source_to_scene is mandatory. Authored cards must specify axes/origin/spacing for 2.3 x 1.0, without inheriting asset axes.

default_geometry_mapping: A/B and L26/L16 are separate entities by default. Future explicit reuse must bind the same entity ID and preserve actual prior operations/location; matching parameters do not establish reuse.
